text:
sienna: Quick check — during the SCIM sync earlier today I noticed a deprovision event for an intern where the email was redacted (good) but the `department` attribute is still in plaintext in the sync logs. Example below. Is department considered PII under our redact policy? /cc @alex_k :eyes:

sienna: ```
2026-04-12T02:10:05Z scim-sync mass-deprovision user=[REDACTED] id=U12345 attrs={department: \"eng-infra\", title: \"intern\"}
```

alex_k: which sync runner? hosted or private customers? I can grep idp-sync-1 logs if you give me the exact timestamp window.

sienna: it's the nightly mass-sync (02:10 UTC). thread_ts 1824500001. The snippet above is from idp-sync-1. I pulled it from /var/log/scim/idp-sync-1/2026-04-12.log.

marco: quick background: PII-redact v2 strips emails, ssn, phone by default but doesn't redact org attrs like `department` because we use them for routing/entitlement. That said, that data shouldn't live in plaintext in long-term logs or wide-access tables.

irina: short-term mitigation: we should stop logging attr payloads at INFO for mass-syncs. Change to `LOG_PAYLOAD=false` or redact `department` in the mapping. Also open an access-review for current viewers of /var/log/scim/* .

alex_k: config lives in infra/idp/scim_mappings.yaml. You can add `redact: [department]` under the `attributes` mapping and restart the service. Quick grep: `rg "mass-deprovision" /var/log/scim | sed -n '1,200p'`

sienna: I'll open a tiny PR to drop dept from logs and tag eng-oncall for a safe deploy window. Do we need to trigger a privacy incident? This was an internal employee not a customer.

marco: not a customer leak, but still a policy gap. I'd classify as low-sev privacy gap (SEV4). File a short privacy-ops ticket so we can track audit + retention change.

irina: I'll file the ticket and start a mini postmortem: include: (1) why mapping included department, (2) who accessed the logs in last 90d, (3) retention/ship off to SIEM. @sienna please attach the grep output.

audit-bot: New access request created: A-324 — reprovision U12345 (requires manager approval). Status: pending. Link: https://redwood.internal/audit/A-324

alex_k: CL for quick fix: branch `fix/scim-redact-department`. Patch: 
```yaml
# infra/idp/scim_mappings.yaml
attributes:
  - name: email
    source: user.email
  - name: department
    source: user.department
    redact: true   # added to prevent plain department in logs
```
Run: `./bin/deploy scim idp-sync-1 --window 03:30-04:00`

sienna: done — PR opened and linked in the ticket. I'll attach the log grep and tag infra and eng-oncall.

marco: thanks. follow-ups: (a) privacy-ops ticket, (b) adjust retention for /var/log/scim to 30d, (c) add CI smoke-test to ensure payload redaction on deprovision events.

irina: I'll take (a) and (b). alex_k can add (c) to the CL.

sienna: great, thanks all. I'll wait for manager approval on the reprovision request before touching the user state. :+1:

alex_k: ack — I'll merge & deploy in the maintenance window once infra gives thumbs up.

marco: closing loop: no external/customer data affected. privacy ops will track as low severity.

sienna: thanks team :pray:
